description: Esquemas de Separação de Tráfego is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Hidrográfico. Este conjunto de dados contém os Esquemas de Separação de Tráfego (EST) para segurança da navegação ao longo da costa Portuguesa, respectivamente o EST do Cabo da Roca e o EST do Cabo de São Vicente. Inclui ar Área A Evitar (AAE) das Berlengas. Coverage: Instituto Hidrográfico. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic Separation Schemes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Hidrográfico. Its keywords include transporte, oceanografia, corredores-de-trafego-maritimo, hvd, redes-de-transporte, oceanos. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
